frameSources.d1: UTC calendar days aggregated from native UTC 4hour

fetch.aggregation: UTC 4h boundaries checked on every source row; UTC daily OHLC uses existing source bars only; no synthetic weekend/holiday candles; first daily date aligned to Monday UTC for complete weekly aggregation.
fetch.datePartition: Intraday YYYYMMDD changes at 06:00 JST (21:00 UTC); request date = UTC date of timestamp + 3h. Native 4hour requests use YYYY.
fetch.responseTimeNote: Historical yearly responses may retain an old responsetime; fetchedUTC is the actual retrieval time. Candle freshness is checked from candle close times.
